title: 利雅德地鐵~Riyadh Metro
focus: 大型新建地鐵網分階段啟用與熱管理~Large new metro network staged launch and thermal management
summary: 以利雅德地鐵分階段投入服務為背景，建立多路線與轉乘節點同時驗收的教學案例。學徒要把高溫冷房、砂塵維護、列車循環和轉乘容量放在共同需求情境，並以各路線分別啟用的狀態表檢查服務邊界。~Use the staged launch of Riyadh Metro to construct a teaching case involving several lines and interchange nodes under acceptance. Place cooling in extreme heat, dust maintenance, fleet circulation and transfer capacity within one demand scenario. Use a state table for separately opened lines to check the service boundary instead of assuming all parts of a new network become available at the same moment.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 air_rise=12.81095 K；單元 2 得 deposit=3.55968 kg；單元 3 得 fan_power=1502.083 W。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 heat 的擾動測試，結果改為 14.09204 K；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以利雅德地鐵分階段投入服務為背景，建立多路線與轉乘節點同時驗收的教學案例。學徒要把高溫冷房、砂塵維護、列車循環和轉乘容量放在共同需求情境，並以各路線分別啟用的狀態表檢查服務邊界。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives air_rise=12.81095 K; unit 2 gives deposit=3.55968 kg; unit 3 gives fan_power=1502.083 W. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing heat in the first unit changes its result to 14.09204 K. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the staged launch of Riyadh Metro to construct a teaching case involving several lines and interchange nodes under acceptance. Place cooling in extreme heat, dust maintenance, fleet circulation and transfer capacity within one demand scenario. Use a state table for separately opened lines to check the service boundary instead of assuming all parts of a new network become available at the same moment. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2024 年：利雅德地鐵第一批路線於十二月開始旅客服務；2025 年：利雅德地鐵橘線於一月加入營運服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以利雅德地鐵分階段投入服務為背景，建立多路線與轉乘節點同時驗收的教學案例。學徒要把高溫冷房、砂塵維護、列車循環和轉乘容量放在共同需求情境，並以各路線分別啟用的狀態表檢查服務邊界。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2024: The first Riyadh Metro lines began passenger service in December; 2025: Riyadh Metro Orange Line joined passenger operations in January. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the staged launch of Riyadh Metro to construct a teaching case involving several lines and interchange nodes under acceptance. Place cooling in extreme heat, dust maintenance, fleet circulation and transfer capacity within one demand scenario. Use a state table for separately opened lines to check the service boundary instead of assuming all parts of a new network become available at the same moment. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 通風散熱與設備溫升~Ventilation cooling and equipment heat
units.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升~Ventilation cooling and equipment heat
units.mechanism: 流動空氣帶走的顯熱與質量流率和溫升相乘，風量不足會提高排氣溫度。設備房還存在短路循環和局部熱點，平均送排風溫差不能保證所有電子模組都在同樣環境中。 顯熱負載決定溫度改變需求，但高濕環境還有潛熱除濕與新風處理。冷卻量和耗電量也不同，兩者需要效率或性能係數連結，不能把熱量數字當作電表讀值。 對大型轉乘站的不同空間分別設定顯熱負載及外氣條件。~Air removes sensible heat through mass flow and temperature rise. Insufficient flow raises exhaust temperature. Equipment rooms also contain recirculation and hot spots, so an average supply-to-exhaust difference does not guarantee identical conditions around every electronic module. Sensible load describes temperature-related demand, while humidity introduces latent dehumidification and outdoor-air treatment. Cooling delivered and electricity consumed are different quantities, connected through efficiency or a performance coefficient rather than treated as identical meter readings. Set sensible loads and outdoor-air conditions separately for different spaces in a large interchange.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K。敏感度：heat 單獨增加百分之十至 20394 W，其餘固定，結果為 14.09204 K。模型邊界：穩態顯熱且混合均勻；不含潛熱、輻射與空調循環效率。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s; calculation: air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K. Sensitivity: heat, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 20394 W, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.09204 K. Model boundary: Steady sensible heat and uniform mixing; latent heat, radiation and refrigeration-cycle efficiency are excluded.
units.verify: 同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。 同步量測進出風溫度、流量和耗電，另記濕度與新風比例，確認顯熱邊界一致。~Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment. Measure inlet and outlet air temperature, airflow and electricity together, separately recording humidity and outdoor-air fraction to confirm consistent sensible boundaries.
units.failure: 濾網堵塞或風道短路會降低有效冷卻，即使總風機轉速正常；散熱器積塵也可能提高晶片溫度而房間平均值不變。 濕度升高仍可能需要更多冷量，即使乾球溫度沒有改變。~A blocked filter or airflow bypass reduces effective cooling despite normal fan speed; dusty heat sinks can raise chip temperature without changing the room average. Rising humidity can require more cooling even if the dry-bulb temperature has not changed.
units.misconception: 風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱~Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet.
units.practice: 比較降低風量與增加設備負載兩種情況，建立溫升敏感度表，再選出能辨別旁通流和真正熱負荷增加的測點。 再以本單元 heat 的對照值重算 air_rise，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare reduced flow with increased equipment load, tabulate temperature sensitivity, and choose sensors distinguishing bypass flow from a genuine load increase. Also recalculate air_rise for the alternative heat value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 砂塵沉積與清理週期~Dust deposition and cleaning interval
units.title: 砂塵沉積與清理週期~Dust deposition and cleaning interval
units.mechanism: 沉積質量可由有效集塵面積、入射質量通量與時間估算，防砂構造改變局部風場也會改變沉積位置。清理週期應依累積量與功能影響決定，而不是把全年平均濃度當成每次沙塵事件。 沉積通量乘接收面積與時間得到積砂質量，通量已是單位面積的到達率。它不同於空氣中的濃度；要從濃度推回沉積，還需風速、粒徑及捕集機制。 用設備表面沉積通量與接收面積建立維修週期中的積砂質量。~Deposited mass can be estimated from effective collection area, incident mass flux and time. Wind barriers alter local airflow and deposition location. Cleaning intervals should follow accumulation and functional impact rather than treating annual mean concentration as a description of every dust event. Deposition flux times receiving area and time gives accumulated sand mass. Flux is already an arrival rate per unit area and differs from airborne concentration. Deriving deposition from concentration also requires wind, particle size and a capture mechanism. Use surface deposition flux and receiving area to estimate sand mass over a maintenance interval.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s；計算：deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg。敏感度：flux 單獨增加百分之十至 9.064e-05 kg/(m^2*s)，其餘固定，結果為 3.915648 kg。模型邊界：固定沉積通量與面積；不含再懸浮、顆粒分徑和風向變化。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s; calculation: deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg. Sensitivity: flux, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 9.064e-05 kg/(m^2*s), with all other inputs fixed, gives 3.915648 kg. Model boundary: Fixed deposition flux and area; resuspension, particle-size distribution and changing wind direction are excluded.
units.verify: 在不同高度和背風位置配置集塵盤，對照風速風向與設備故障紀錄，量出事件累積量而非只取單點濃度。 用已知面積收集盤在指定時間稱重，保留風向與取樣位置，並檢查再懸浮和散失。~Place deposition trays at different heights and sheltered locations, correlate with wind and equipment records, and measure event accumulation rather than one concentration reading. Weigh collection trays of known area over a stated interval, retain wind direction and sampling location, and inspect resuspension and losses.
units.failure: 防風牆可能把沉積集中到設備附近，清理不到的角落會比平均面積更快受堵；濕砂還可能附著於絕緣表面。 平均沉積通量可能漏掉局部堆砂，須比較不同設備位置。~A wind barrier may concentrate deposits near equipment, inaccessible corners can clog faster than the mean, and wet dust can adhere to insulating surfaces. Mean deposition flux can hide local drifts; compare different equipment locations.
units.misconception: 防風牆一旦設置就必定讓所有位置的砂塵沉積同時下降~Installing a wind barrier necessarily reduces dust deposition at every location.
units.practice: 比較同總入砂量的均勻與集中沉積，設計清理頻率表，說明為何要保留風向與設備位置而不能只報總重量。 再以本單元 flux 的對照值重算 deposit，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare uniform and concentrated deposition at equal total input, design a cleaning-interval table, and explain why wind direction and equipment location matter beyond total mass. Also recalculate deposit for the alternative flux value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 濾網壓差與通風功率~Filter pressure drop and fan power
units.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率~Filter pressure drop and fan power
units.mechanism: 風機必須克服風道與濾網壓差才能輸送空氣，輸入功率近似為壓差乘體積流率再除效率。積塵提高阻力但工作點會沿風機曲線改變，因此固定風量假設只是一種受控比較。 風機功率等於壓力差乘體積流率再除以宣告效率，壓力與流量必須使用同一工作點。積塵使阻力和風機工作點共同改變，固定流量算例不能預測未控制風量時的耗電。 把濾材積塵造成的壓差與風機調速造成的壓差區分。~A fan must overcome duct and filter pressure losses to move air. Input power is approximately pressure rise times volume flow divided by efficiency. Dust raises resistance but shifts the operating point on the fan curve, so fixed flow is only a controlled comparison. Fan power equals pressure difference times volume flow divided by the declared efficiency. Pressure and flow must refer to one operating point. Dust changes resistance and the fan operating point together, so a fixed-flow example cannot predict consumption without airflow control. Distinguish filter-loading pressure drop from pressure changes caused by fan-speed control.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=360.5 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1；計算：fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1502.083 W。敏感度：pressure 單獨增加百分之十至 396.55 Pa，其餘固定，結果為 1652.292 W。模型邊界：固定風量與總效率；不包含風機曲線移動和馬達熱限制。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=360.5 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1; calculation: fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1502.083 W. Sensitivity: pressure, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 396.55 Pa, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1652.292 W. Model boundary: Fixed flow and overall efficiency; fan-curve shifts and motor thermal limits are excluded.
units.verify: 同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。 校正取壓點與風量計，同步量測電功率，核對效率是否包含馬達與驅動器損失。~Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing. Calibrate pressure taps and airflow measurement, record electric power simultaneously, and check whether efficiency includes motor and drive losses.
units.failure: 旁路漏氣可能讓壓差降低但過濾品質變差；只以壓差低判定良好，會忽略濾網破損和密封失效。 壓差很低也可能是旁通，須核對濾材密封及實際風量。~Bypass leakage may lower pressure drop while worsening filtration; a low drop alone can therefore hide a damaged filter or failed seal. Very low pressure drop can indicate bypass; check filter sealing and actual airflow.
units.misconception: 濾網壓差越低就一定表示過濾狀況越好~Lower filter pressure drop always means better filtration condition.
units.practice: 對堵塞與旁路兩個情境列出壓差、風量和粒子濃度的預期方向，設計三項量測共同判斷而非只靠單一數字。 再以本單元 pressure 的對照值重算 fan_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Predict pressure drop, airflow and particle concentration for clogging and bypass scenarios, then design a three-measurement diagnosis instead of relying on one number. Also recalculate fan_power for the alternative pressure value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.mechanism: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 在多路線尚未全開時重算可用轉乘路徑和等待時間。~A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Recalculate available transfer paths and waiting times while some lines remain unopened.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=185.4 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=69.6 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 203.94 m，其餘固定，結果為 51.06 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=185.4 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=69.6 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 203.94 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 51.06 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。~Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.
units.failure: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。~Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.
units.misconception: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接~The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
units.practice: 比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 月台暫存與隊列守恆~Platform storage and queue conservation
units.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆~Platform storage and queue conservation
units.mechanism: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 以分階段開放的出口數檢查有效候車與通行面積。~Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity. Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Check effective waiting and circulation area under a staged number of open exits.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 477至 477 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.362857 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 477, to 477 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.362857 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded.
units.verify: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。~Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Cross-check total occupancy with zonal video counts, measure net area, and record local bottlenecks and entry-exit flows simultaneously.
units.failure: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。~A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones.
units.misconception: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞~Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
units.practice: 模擬一列取消後兩個班距內的人數變化，扣除不能站立的面積，提出分流措施並比較它們改變的是流量還是暫存容量。 再以本單元 people 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 周轉時間與車隊需求~Round-trip time and fleet size
units.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求~Round-trip time and fleet size
units.mechanism: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。備用車和維修車需另列；只用單程行車時間會把車隊需求低估接近一半。 循環時間除以班距後必須向上取整，半列車不能提供完整班次。此數量是投入循環的最低值，維修備用、延誤緩衝與不同分支運轉仍需額外配置。 按每條線完整循環估算車數，再辨認共用備援的限制。~Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward. The cycle includes terminal turnbacks and stops. Spares and maintenance vehicles are additional; using only one-way running time can underestimate the requirement by nearly half. Divide cycle time by headway and round upward because a fraction of a train cannot provide a full departure. This is the minimum circulating requirement; maintenance spares, delay buffers and branch-specific operation need additional allocation. Estimate fleet size from each line’s complete cycle and identify limits of shared spares.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5562 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=31 trains。敏感度：cycle 單獨增加百分之十至 6118.2 s，其餘固定，結果為 34 trains。模型邊界：固定周轉與班距、無延誤；不含備用率和維修排程。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5562 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=31 trains. Sensitivity: cycle, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 6118.2 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 34 trains. Model boundary: Fixed cycle and headway without delays; reserve ratio and maintenance scheduling are excluded.
units.verify: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。 核對往返與折返時間使用同一單位，以逐列時刻表重播，檢查每次發車是否有車可用。~Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time. Verify consistent units for round-trip and turnaround times, replay a train-by-train timetable, and check vehicle availability at every departure.
units.failure: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。~Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient.
units.misconception: 車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定~Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
units.practice: 增加一端折返時間後重算車隊，檢查向上取整造成的跳變，再提出維修備用與臨時故障應如何另列。 再以本單元 cycle 的對照值重算 fleet，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase one terminal turnback time, recalculate fleet and examine rounding jumps, then explain separate allowances for maintenance reserve and unexpected failures. Also recalculate fleet for the alternative cycle value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.mechanism: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 在試運轉和載客區段之間建立不可同時成立的進路。~Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Build mutually exclusive routes between testing and passenger-service sections.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=7 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=128 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 8 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 256 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=7 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=128 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 8 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 256 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.
units.verify: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。~Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority.
units.failure: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。~Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.
units.misconception: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求~Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
units.practice: 為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.mechanism: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 檢查多路線資料交換的封包時效，不把收到訊息當成許可。~A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Check packet freshness in inter-line data exchange rather than treating receipt as permission.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3399 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.4975 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3399 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.4975 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded.
units.verify: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。~Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption.
units.failure: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。~Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery.
units.misconception: 平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達~A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
units.practice: 把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 備援電池與可維持時間~Backup battery endurance
units.title: 備援電池與可維持時間~Backup battery endurance
units.mechanism: 備援電池可供負載使用的能量由額定容量、允許放電深度和轉換效率相乘，除負載功率得到理想時間。低溫、老化及啟動電流會縮短可用時間；額定安時也不能直接當成瓦時。 可用電量應扣除允許放電深度與轉換損失，負載也可能隨時間變化。銘牌容量的測試溫度和放電倍率會影響實際結果，續航計算不能取代受控放電驗證。 把高溫下緊急照明和通訊耗電分別納入備援估算。~Usable backup energy combines rated energy, permitted discharge fraction and conversion efficiency. Dividing by load gives ideal endurance. Cold temperature, ageing and start-up current can shorten it; an ampere-hour rating must not be mistaken directly for watt-hours. Usable energy must account for permitted discharge depth and conversion losses, while load may vary over time. Test temperature and discharge rate influence rated capacity, so an endurance calculation cannot replace controlled discharge verification. Include emergency lighting and communication consumption separately in hot-condition backup estimates.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=20.6 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW；計算：endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.708 h。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 22.66 kWh，其餘固定，結果為 4.0788 h。模型邊界：固定負載與額定能量；不含電池倍率效應、溫度與容量衰退。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=20.6 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW; calculation: endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.708 h. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22.66 kWh, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4.0788 h. Model boundary: Constant load and nominal energy; rate effects, temperature and capacity degradation are excluded.
units.verify: 定期以已知負載做受控放電，量端電壓、電流及溫度，核對控制器切離點與真正可用能量。 以受控負載記錄電池電壓、電流與溫度，積分可用電量，核對低壓切斷時刻。~Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy. Record battery voltage, current and temperature under controlled load, integrate usable energy, and verify the low-voltage cut-off time.
units.failure: 老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。 電池電壓正常不代表容量足夠，需檢查負載下放電曲線。~An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks. Normal open-circuit voltage does not prove sufficient capacity; inspect the loaded discharge curve.
units.misconception: 備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間~Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration.
units.practice: 將負載增加一成並把可用容量降為老化假設值，重新計算時間，提出量測端電壓以外必須保留的證據。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 endurance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase load and reduce usable capacity for an ageing case, recalculate endurance, and identify evidence required beyond terminal-voltage readings. Also recalculate endurance for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.title: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.mechanism: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 用逐線停機紀錄計算可用性，避免網路平均掩蓋單線中斷。~In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Calculate availability from line-specific outages instead of hiding one line’s failure in a network average.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1236 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967742 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1359.6 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9970666 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1236 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967742 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1359.6 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9970666 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.
units.verify: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。~Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.
units.failure: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。~Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.
units.misconception: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低~High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
units.practice: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

facts: 已查證背景：2024 年，利雅德地鐵第一批路線於十二月開始旅客服務。~Verified background: 2024, The first Riyadh Metro lines began passenger service in December.
教學假設，單元 1：heat=18540 W，計算 air_rise=12.81095 K；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 1: heat=18540 W, calculated air_rise=12.81095 K; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 2：flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s)，計算 deposit=3.55968 kg；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 2: flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s), calculated deposit=3.55968 kg; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 3：pressure=360.5 Pa，計算 fan_power=1502.083 W；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 3: pressure=360.5 Pa, calculated fan_power=1502.083 W; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 4：distance=185.4 m，計算 margin=69.6 s；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 4: distance=185.4 m, calculated margin=69.6 s; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 5：people=433 persons，計算 density=1.237143 persons/m^2；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 5: people=433 persons, calculated density=1.237143 persons/m^2; not measured performance.
